Thanks for the heads up, Priya — both new options look good on our side. Well confirm Mon 7/8, 10:00 PDT. Ill send a calendar invite and an updated agenda now.

Quick answers to the asks so procurement/security have something in hand before the call:
- Token/log retention: default retention for request/response logs is 30 days; we offer configurable retention windows and can set a shorter window for pilot engagements.
- Data residency: hosted Redwood endpoints are region-specific; we can discuss VPC/private deployment options if you need an on-prem or VPC-launched pilot.

Attached: high-level security requirements doc we typically review during discovery. Karthik will walk through the checklist and the items in your network diagram.
